feature: PLUS court reduction (POST /v1/plus-apply-reduction-court): hanya mengubah amount_payable untuk notice di stage court, tanpa TS-RED, tanpa baris suspended_notice atau reduced_offence_amount
note: Endpoint terpisah dari reduction biasa: tidak ada idempotency, tidak membuat TS-RED, hanya memperbarui amount_payable di intranet dan eVON. Tidak ada story di chunk OCMS16.1-16.5 yang menyebut reduction court. Dibaca langsung dari code; pemanggil (PLUS): cannot verify from repo.
note_en: Separate from the normal reduction: no idempotency, no TS-RED, only updates amount_payable in intranet and eVON. None of the stories in chunk OCMS16.1-16.5 mention court reduction. Read directly from the code; the caller (PLUS): cannot verify from repo.

feature: PLUS revert reduction court (POST /v1/plus-revert-reduction-court): mengembalikan amount_payable ke originalAmount untuk notice di stage court
note: Menolak notice di luar COURT_STAGES lalu menulis amount_payable = originalAmount di VON dan eVON. Pasangan court dari reduction; tidak ada story di chunk ini yang memintanya.
note_en: Rejects notices outside COURT_STAGES, then writes amount_payable = originalAmount on the VON and eVON. The court counterpart of reduction; no story in this chunk asks for it.

feature: Revert amount payable saat TS-RED di-revive (membaca amount_payable asli dari ocms_reduced_offence_amount)
note: revertCompositionAmountIfReduced mengembalikan amount_payable VON dan eVON ke nilai sebelum reduction saat TS-RED direvive (OCMS-DF-2026-028 / OCMS-DF-2026-072). Perilaku masa berlaku habis ini tidak diminta eksplisit oleh story OCMS16.1-16.5.
note_en: revertCompositionAmountIfReduced restores the VON and eVON amount_payable to the pre-reduction value when a TS-RED is revived (OCMS-DF-2026-028 / OCMS-DF-2026-072). This after-expiry behaviour is not explicitly requested by stories OCMS16.1-16.5.
